Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 538,505,890.09, Q2 RMB 661,354,777.39, Q3 RMB 593,660,910.40, Q4 RMB 739,117,791.79. Overseas revenue RMB 1,505,341,836.71 (+94.29%), 59.44% of revenue. quarterly_data.quarter: Broadex Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Segments and capacity (annual report): datacom, consumer and industrial interconnect revenue RMB 2,038,769,308.96 in 2025, up 89.86%, 80.50% of revenue, gross margin 46.58% (up 7.51 points), on compute demand from cloud, AI and big data; capacity 2338 ten-thousand units, output 1,564.25 ten-thousand units (+12.16%), sales volume 1,301.99 ten-thousand units (-0.25%). Telecom revenue RMB 480,795,926.96, down 28.21% on the industry cycle and competition, gross margin 15.56%; capacity 1254 ten-thousand units, output 572.26 ten-thousand units (+27.41%). Year-end inventory rose 87.36% (datacom) and 92.89% (telecom), which the company attributes to stocking for higher customer orders. Two customers' orders won by tender or other process: 1828171 units for RMB 275,464,540.40 (10.88% of revenue) and 1350570 units for RMB 162,051,861.12 (6.40%), names not disclosed.

quarterly_data.quarter: Broadex Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Production footprint (annual report): the company now runs a '1+3' production system, Indonesia overseas plus Jiaxing, Chengdu and Hanchuan in China. The raised-fund Chengdu Rongbo communication park was completed and put into production in June 2025 (budget RMB 250,330,000.00, 97.46% of budget invested); the Changxinsheng Indonesia phase-2 project is complete and phase 3 (budget RMB 270,608,800.00) was 15.95% complete at end-2025 and is proceeding on plan. In January 2025 the company redirected the raised funds of its 2.45 million-unit-a-year silicon-photonics transceiver upgrade project to buying 18.16% of Changxinsheng (Wuhan), lifting its stake from 42.29% to 60.45%.
quarterly_data.figure: Indonesia phase 3 budget RMB 270,608,800.00, 15.95% complete; Chengdu park in production June 2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Broadex Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products in 2025 (annual report): 400G/800G AEC products and multimode 400G SR4 and 800G SR8 optical modules have volume supply capability; athermal AWG (AAWG) for data-center interconnect shipped in volume; MEMS optical switches and optical channel monitors (OCM) completed technical verification and entered market promotion; the ultra-high-density SNMT optical connector entered volume production while MMC/EBO connectors are in development and validation; a dual-channel 10G MIPI D-PHY SerDes chip passed internal verification and entered mass-production introduction at key customers. A silicon-based high-speed optical transceiver R&D project is partly complete. The company says subsidiary Changxinsheng's in-house multi-channel optoelectronic transceiver chips for AOC hold a leading global market share.

quarterly_data.quarter: Broadex Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report, company plan): the company says datacom, consumer and industrial interconnect demand is strong and data-center networks are moving quickly to 800G, 1.6T and even 3.2T, while the telecom market is under pressure. It plans to shift from single-component supply to complete solutions and from passive to active products with more in-house core devices, add new-product development and supply capacity, expand overseas capacity as customers require, build out sales in North America and Europe, and cultivate new core customers to balance its customer structure.
